description: This is a source class file defining the ProjectDecorator class in the namespace OrangeHRM\Entity\Decorator. It provides methods to manipulate Project entity objects, including setting customers and project administrators, with typical object-oriented patterns and PHP traits.

classes.name: ProjectDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Project entity allowing for additional behavior such as assigning customers and admins.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method accepting a Project object and initializing the decorator.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the Project object being decorated.

methods.name: setCustomerById
methods.description: Sets the customer of the project using a customer ID.

methods.name: setProjectAdminsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Assigns project admins based on an array of employee numbers.

methods.name: addProjectAdmin
methods.description: Private method to add a single Employee as a project admin.

methods.name: removeProjectAdmins
methods.description: Removes all project admins from the project.
